description: React component for displaying and managing a vendor card in an admin dashboard, including view, edit, delete functionalities, and context interactions.

methods.name: VendorCard
methods.description: Main React component function rendering a vendor card with actions.

methods.name: onVendorCardClicked
methods.description: Handles clicking on the vendor card to set selected vendor ID and store info in local storage.

methods.name: onHandlerEdit
methods.description: Triggers the display of the vendor edit form.

methods.name: onHandleConfirmDeleteVendor
methods.description: Confirms and executes vendor deletion via GraphQL mutation.

methods.name: onHandlerView
methods.description: Navigates to the vendor's detailed view page.
